codebase decision, not user: .sidebar-wrap is position:fixed, so .sidebar-shell's width is what actually reserves the layout column - a transform animates pixels but reserves no space. Documented at Layout.css:320-324 and DESIGN.md Navigation; zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion at Layout.css:280-287.

codebase decision, not user: paired half of .sidebar-shell's width transition - .main-content must resize in lockstep or it ends the animation at the wrong width, which is what every table's available width is measured against. Documented at Layout.css:320-324; zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion at Layout.css:280-287.

Sidebar collapse: .sidebar-wrap animates width 240<->56px and .main-content its matching margin-left in lockstep (Layout.css L361/L863). A transform cannot express it — the content column's reserved space must actually change, or the sidebar slides OVER the content instead of the page reflowing. Sanctioned since 2026-08-18; the two per-value entries recording that decision are inert, because extractFindingIgnoreValue() returns '' for layout-transition (not in directValueRules), so only a file-scoped wildcard can suppress it. Rationale also in DESIGN.md and .claude/rules/design-system.md.

80mm thermal parking-slip print template (parkingSlipHtml.js) - vehicle number sized for a printed token; print templates are the documented allowed class, value predates S754. S765 ADDED the files: key - without it this was a GLOBAL value suppression while its reason named one file, so it silently exempted 26px on eight on-screen sites (ImsCountLogin, PosLogin, GuestMenu, Pricing x3, Settings, ClientDrawer, ArrivalAlert.css) and the detector read as passing on all of them. An ignore is scoped to the thing that is genuinely exempt.

DESIGN.md -> Shapes names .guest-menu as one of the two sanctioned radius exemptions: the scoped guest surfaces keep their own shape language for the same reason they keep their own palette. Directory-scoped because the hook reports the path as GuestMenu.css (derived from the component name) while the file is guestMenu.css, so the S759 per-basename entries never matched. A per-value ignore with no --file would have exempted 8px/4px product-wide and defeated the Modernist zero-radius rule.
